text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...My body feels so heavy...
Going into training like this
probably isn't a good idea...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I need to loosen up properly so I don't get hurt.
Let's keep warming up...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's no good, it's not feeling any lighter at all...
I need to be more thorough until it completely loosens up...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation doesn't seem to be moving as well as she'd like. Could it be due to the consecutive races? We might need to reconsider her upcoming schedule.
